text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Bright having not shown up
for
training, I head off to look for her.
Then, while
searching...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Wooow... That cloud looks just like a
little bird...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are you flying over to that big, puffy
cloud, little
bird?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You can make it! It's perfectly fine to
drift slowly
but surely. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, greetings, Trainer. I've been gazing
at the
clouds up in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, it's as if a story is unfolding before
my very
eyes. I could watch them all day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: トレーニングは、忘れずにな
トレーニングは、忘れずにね
choice_data_list_en: Don't forget about training, all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, sincerely... I only meant to
gaze at
the clouds for a few moments...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have brought shame to the Mejiro
name. You
have my word that this will
not happen again...
